## [1.1.1](https://github.com/hemk651/meta-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1) (2026-11-18)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ci:** clean and verify release bundle version ([80641ac](https://github.com/hemk651/meta-patches/commit/80641ac230ea920ede07df55c76beb5f25a39f3d))
* **release:** correct release command encoding ([8228b2a](https://github.com/hemk651/meta-patches/commit/8228b2aab7e15cf6ebdf74b090ce0b325215aa0b))
* **release:** rebuild bundle after version bump ([1d7a0d6](https://github.com/hemk651/meta-patches/commit/1d7a0d63f24d7f7ed75feb843818c1653dda5d4a))

patches.name: AMOLED theme
patches.description: Forces Instagram dark theme surfaces to pure black (AMOLED).

patches.name: Add Mods menu
patches.description: Adds the Mods menu (fork of the InstaFL menu): long press the home feed to open the quick menu, incl. developer options.

patches.name: Change channel name
patches.description: Replaces the release channel name (NONE, ALPHA, BETA, PROD) shown in the developer options UI.

options.description: The name shown in place of the release channel.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes ads in Instagram by stopping the ad pod flow.

patches.name: Remove snooze warning
patches.description: Removes the "build expired" snooze warning dialog that alpha builds show.

patches.name: Unlock developer options
patches.description: Unlocks the developer options: writes the MobileConfig overrides file that reveals Developer options in the settings together with a dedicated Employee options entry, and forces the employee options gate to true (shake-gesture entry). The overrides file becomes active after an app restart.

patches.name: Upload instants from gallary
patches.description: Adds a gallery button to the Instants camera to post photos and videos from your device's gallery.

patches.name: Instants Mod
patches.description: Adds a gallery button to post photos and videos, and allows saving friends' Instants to your device.
